description: Protein-level co-detection statistics for the AT5G03810/AT5G03820 tandem pair
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import spearmanr, pearsonr
M=pd.read_csv("artifacts/proteomics_E-PROT-135_rows.csv",index_col=0)
a=M.loc["AT5G03810"].astype(float); b=M.loc["AT5G03820"].astype(float)
rho,pr=spearmanr(a,b); r,pp=pearsonr(np.log1p(a),np.log1p(b))
print("protein-level across 30 tissues: Spearman rho=%.3f p=%.2g ; Pearson(log1p) r=%.3f p=%.2g"%(rho,pr,r,pp))
both=((a>0)&(b>0)).sum(); only10=((a>0)&(b==0)).sum(); only20=((a==0)&(b>0)).sum(); neither=((a==0)&(b==0)).sum()
print("co-detected %d, 3810-only %d, 3820-only %d, neither %d"%(both,only10,only20,neither))
print("abundance ratio 3820/3810 in co-detected tissues: median %.1f"%np.median((b[(a>0)&(b>0)]/a[(a>0)&(b>0)]).values))
# transcript vs protein for AT5G03810
T=pd.read_csv("artifacts/expression_E-MTAB-7978.csv",index_col=0)
print("\ntranscript E-MTAB-7978 AT5G03810 top tissues:")
print(T["AT5G03810"].sort_values(ascending=False).head(6).round(2).to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.4))
lab=[c.replace("continuous light regimen, ","").replace("long day length regimen (16h/8h), ","") for c in M.columns]
ax[0].scatter(np.log1p(b),np.log1p(a),s=26,c="#2b6cb0")
for i,l in enumerate(lab):
    if a.values[i]>0: ax[0].annotate(l,(np.log1p(b.values[i]),np.log1p(a.values[i])),fontsize=5.5)
ax[0].set_xlabel("AT5G03820 protein, log1p abundance"); ax[0].set_ylabel("AT5G03810 protein, log1p abundance")
ax[0].set_title("Paralog pair co-detected at protein level\nSpearman rho=%.2f, p=%.1g (30 tissues)"%(rho,pr),fontsize=9)
o=a.sort_values(ascending=False); l2=[lab[list(M.columns).index(c)] for c in o.index]
ax[1].barh(range(len(o))[::-1],o.values,color=["#c05621" if v>0 else "#ccc" for v in o.values])
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(o))[::-1]); ax[1].set_yticklabels(l2,fontsize=5.5)
ax[1].set_xscale("symlog"); ax[1].set_xlabel("AT5G03810 protein abundance (E-PROT-135)")
ax[1].set_title("AT5G03810 protein: 11 of 30 tissues, seed-weighted",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
